source_refs.note: Exercise 4.1, Question 1 (i)-(v): order and degree; book p. 128, answers p. 303 (PDF 305)

blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Write the order and degree (if defined) of the following differential equation: \(\frac{d^{3}y}{dx^{2}} + 7\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}} - 9xy\frac{dy}{dx} + x^{2}y = 0\) [first term printed as \(d^{3}y/dx^{2}\); intended \(d^{3}y/dx^{3}\), see the correction below]
blocks.explanation:
Yeh order aur degree ka sawal hai. Order ka matlab hai sab se oonche derivative ka order, aur degree ka matlab hai usi derivative ki power, jab equation derivatives mein polynomial ho.
Pehle ek baat: kitab ne pehli term \(\frac{d^{3}y}{dx^{2}}\) chhapi hai jo ghalat nishan hai; asal mein \(\frac{d^{3}y}{dx^{3}}\) murad hai (neeche correction dekhiye).
Plan: tamam derivatives ki list banayenge, sab se oonchi chunenge, phir us ki power dekhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\frac{d^{3}y}{dx^{3}} + 7\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}} - 9xy\frac{dy}{dx} + x^{2}y = 0\).
Maloom karna: order aur degree.
Tareeqa: derivatives ki list, sab se oonchi se order, phir dekhna ke equation derivatives mein polynomial hai ya nahi, aur oonche derivative ki power se degree.

Derivatives ki list banaiye
\[\dfrac{d^{3}y}{dx^{3}},\quad \dfrac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}},\quad \dfrac{dy}{dx}\]
Sab se oonchi \(\frac{d^{3}y}{dx^{3}}\) hai, is liye order 3 hai.
Kyun: order hamesha sab se oonche derivative ka order hota hai. \(d\) ke upar likha 3 batata hai ke \(y\) ko teen dafa differentiate kiya gaya hai.
Dhyan dein: yeh 3 power nahi, order hai.
Sochiye ke order aisa hai jaise kisi ghar ki sab se oonchi manzil: ghar mein kitni bhi manzilen hon, hum sirf sab se oonchi ginte hain. Yahan teesri manzil \(\frac{d^{3}y}{dx^{3}}\) sab se oonchi hai.

Degree parhiye
Koi derivative root ke neeche ya sin jaise function ke andar nahi, is liye equation pehle hi derivatives mein polynomial hai. \(\frac{d^{3}y}{dx^{3}}\) ki power 1 hai, is liye degree 1 hai.
Kyun: degree mein sirf highest derivative ki power ginti hoti hai. \(-9xy\) aur \(x^{2}y\) sirf \(x\) aur \(y\) ke functions hain, in ki powers se degree par koi asar nahi parta.
Yaad rakhiye: degree dekhne se pehle hamesha teen sawal poochiye: kya koi derivative root ke neeche hai? kya koi derivative sin, cos ya \(e\) ke andar hai? agar dono ka jawab nahi, to seedhi power parh lijiye.

Tasdeeq:
Answer key order 3, degree 1 deti hai, jo hamare jawab se milti hai. Is se yeh bhi pakka ho gaya ke kitab ka irada \(\frac{d^{3}y}{dx^{3}}\) hi tha.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein pehli term \(\frac{d^{3}y}{dx^{2}}\) chhapi hai. Yeh derivative ka sahi nishan hi nahi, kyunke \(d\) ke upar wala number aur \(dx\) wala number hamesha barabar hote hain. Sahi term \(\frac{d^{3}y}{dx^{3}}\) hai, aur answer key (order 3, degree 1) bhi isi ko maan kar likhi gayi hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Write the order and degree (if defined) of the following differential equation: \(\left(\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\right)^{3} + \frac{dy}{dx} = 1\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi order aur degree ka sawal hai, aur equation derivatives mein seedha polynomial hai.
Sab se pehle highest derivative pehchanna hai: woh \(\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\) hai.
Phir dekhna hai ke us par power kitni lagi hai; wohi degree hogi.
Dhyan rahe ke \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) ki power yahan kaam ki nahi.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\left(\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\right)^{3} + \frac{dy}{dx} = 1\).
Maloom karna: order aur degree.
Tareeqa: highest derivative se order, phir us ki power se degree.

Order
Derivatives hain \(\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\) aur \(\frac{dy}{dx}\); in mein sab se ooncha \(\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\) hai, is liye order 2 hai.
Kyun: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) sirf pehla derivative hai, jab ke \(\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\) doosra.

Degree
Equation \(\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\) aur \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) mein polynomial hai, aur \(\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\) par power 3 lagi hai, is liye degree 3 hai.
Kyun: degree highest-order derivative ki power hoti hai, aur yahan bracket ke bahar cube highest derivative par hi laga hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\left(\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\right)^{3}\) ka matlab hai doosre derivative ka cube; yeh teesra derivative nahi hai, is liye order 3 nahi hota.
Is ko ek aur tarah dekhiye: agar \(p = \frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\) aur \(q = \frac{dy}{dx}\) likhein to equation \(p^{3} + q = 1\) ban jati hai, jo \(p\) mein teesre darje (third degree) ka polynomial hai. Isi liye degree 3.

Tasdeeq:
Answer key: order 2, degree 3. Hamara jawab milta hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iii) Write the order and degree (if defined) of the following differential equation: \(\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}} + \sin\left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right) = 0\)
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein ek derivative sine ke andar phansa hua hai, aur yahi is ki khaas baat hai.
Order to aasani se mil jayega, kyunke highest derivative saaf nazar aa raha hai.
Lekin degree ke liye equation ka derivatives mein polynomial hona zaroori hai, aur sin ko koi algebra hata nahi sakti.
Is liye degree defined nahi hogi.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}} + \sin\left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right) = 0\).
Maloom karna: order aur degree (agar defined ho).
Tareeqa: pehle order; phir check karna ke equation derivatives mein polynomial ban sakti hai ya nahi.

Order
Sab se ooncha derivative \(\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\) hai, is liye order 2 hai.
Kyun: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) sirf first order ka hai; sine ke andar hone se us ka order nahi badalta.

Degree
\(p = \frac{dy}{dx}\) likhiye. Phir
\[\sin p = p - \dfrac{p^{3}}{3!} + \dfrac{p^{5}}{5!} - \cdots\]
yeh kabhi khatam na hone wali series hai jis ki koi aakhri (sab se bari) power nahi. Is liye equation derivatives mein polynomial nahi, aur degree defined nahi.
Kyun: degree tab hi hoti hai jab poori equation apne tamam derivatives mein polynomial ho; sin ise kharab kar deta hai.
Dhyan dein: yeh kehna ke "\(\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\) ki power 1 hai, is liye degree 1" ghalat hai, kyunke shart poori equation ke polynomial hone ki hai.
Asaan alfaz mein: sin ek aisa dabba hai jis ke andar band derivative ko koi power, koi square ya cube bahar nahi nikal sakta. Jab tak derivative bahar na aaye, polynomial nahi banta, aur polynomial ke baghair degree ka sawal hi paida nahi hota. Exam mein yahan sirf itna likhna kaafi hai: "derivative sine ke andar hai, is liye degree defined nahi".

Tasdeeq:
Answer key: order 2, degree undefined. Hamara jawab milta hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iv) Write the order and degree (if defined) of the following differential equation: \(\frac{dy}{dx} + e^{y}\sin(x) = 0\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh first-order equation ka order aur degree hai.
Yahan \(e^{y}\) aur \(\sin x\) dekh kar ghabrana nahi: yeh \(y\) aur \(x\) ke functions hain, kisi derivative ke nahi.
Is liye yeh degree par koi asar nahi dalte.
Plan: highest derivative aur us ki power.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\frac{dy}{dx} + e^{y}\sin x = 0\).
Maloom karna: order aur degree.
Tareeqa: highest derivative aur us ki power.

Order
Equation mein sirf ek derivative \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) hai, is liye order 1 hai.
Kyun: yahan na doosra derivative hai na teesra.

Degree
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = -e^{y}\sin x\]
Yeh \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) mein power 1 ka polynomial hai, is liye degree 1 hai.
Kyun: \(e^{y}\) sirf \(y\) ka function hai. Degree tab undefined hoti jab derivative khud exponential ke andar hota, jaise \(e^{dy/dx}\).
Dhyan dein: \(e^{y}\) aur \(e^{dy/dx}\) mein zameen aasman ka farq hai.
Yeh sawal isi liye diya gaya hai ke student \(e^{y}\) dekh kar ghabra jaye aur "degree defined nahi" likh de. Lekin \(e^{y}\) mein koi derivative nahi; yeh to bas \(y\) ka ek function hai, bilkul \(y^{2}\) ya \(\sin y\) ki tarah.

Tasdeeq:
Answer key "order 3, degree 2" likhti hai; yeh is equation ka jawab ho hi nahi sakta, kyunke is mein na teesra derivative hai na kisi derivative ka square (neeche correction dekhiye).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key part (iv) ke liye "order 3, degree 2" deti hai. Chhapi hui equation \(\frac{dy}{dx} + e^{y}\sin(x) = 0\) mein sirf pehla derivative hai aur woh bhi power 1 ke saath. Sahi jawab: order 1, degree 1.

blocks.prompt: 1 (v) Write the order and degree (if defined) of the following differential equation: \(\cos x\left(\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}} + \frac{dy}{dx} + y = 0\)
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein highest derivative par fractional power \(\frac{1}{3}\) lagi hui hai.
Fractional power ko dono sides ka cube le kar hataya ja sakta hai, is liye degree defined hai; bas pehle use saaf karna zaroori hai.
Diya hua: equation; find karna: order aur degree.
Plan: order seedha parhenge, phir cube root wali term akeli kar ke cube lenge, aur phir degree parhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\cos x\left(\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\right)^{1/3} + \frac{dy}{dx} + y = 0\).
Maloom karna: order aur degree.
Tareeqa: highest derivative se order; phir power \(\frac{1}{3}\) wali term ko akela kar ke dono sides ka cube.

Order
Sab se ooncha derivative \(\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\) hai, is liye order 2 hai.
Kyun: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) sirf first order ka hai.

Fractional power wali term akeli kijiye
\[\cos x\left(\dfrac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}} = -\left(\dfrac{dy}{dx} + y\right)\]
Kyun: cube root wali term ek taraf akeli hogi tabhi cube lene se woh poori tarah saaf hogi. Agar baqi terms saath rehti to cube lene par cube root wali terms phir bhi bach jatin.

Dono sides ka cube lijiye
\[\cos^{3}x\,\dfrac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}} = -\left(\dfrac{dy}{dx} + y\right)^{3}\]
\[\cos^{3}x\,\dfrac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}} + \left(\dfrac{dy}{dx} + y\right)^{3} = 0\]
Kyun: \(\left(a^{1/3}\right)^{3} = a\). Cube lene se solutions nahi badalte, kyunke har real number ka sirf ek real cube root hota hai, is liye nayi equation purani ke barabar hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\cos x\) ka bhi cube hota hai, \(\cos^{3}x\).
Yeh qadam is liye zaroori hai ke degree hamesha polynomial shakal mein hi parhi jati hai. Cube root ko aap ek taala samjhiye aur cube ko us ki chaabi: chaabi lagate hi taala khul jata hai aur derivative bahar aa jata hai.

Degree parhiye
Ab equation derivatives mein polynomial hai. \(\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\) ki power 1 hai, is liye degree 1 hai.
Kyun: \(\left(\frac{dy}{dx} + y\right)\) par laga cube chhote derivative ka hai, woh ginti mein nahi aata; \(\cos^{3}x\) sirf \(x\) ka function hai.
Muqabla kijiye part (iii) se: wahan sin ka taala tha jis ki koi chaabi nahi, is liye degree undefined. Yahan cube root ka taala tha jis ki chaabi cube hai, is liye degree defined, aur woh 1 hai.

Tasdeeq (sympy):
\(\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\) aur \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) ko symbols \(p_{2}\), \(p_{1}\) maan kar \(\cos^{3}x\,p_{2} + (p_{1} + y)^{3}\) ki \(p_{2}\) mein degree 1 aati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key is jawab ko "(vi)" ka label deti hai (exercise mein part (vi) hai hi nahi; yeh part (v) hai) aur "order 2, degree undefined" likhti hai. Order theek hai, lekin degree defined hai: power \(\frac{1}{3}\) cube lene se hat jati hai aur \(\cos^{3}x\,\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}} + \left(\frac{dy}{dx} + y\right)^{3} = 0\) milti hai, jis mein \(\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\) ki power 1 hai. Sahi jawab: order 2, degree 1. (Degree sirf tab undefined hoti hai jab derivative sin jaise function ke andar ho, jaise part (iii) mein.)
